macros.name: CaptionFonts
macros.doc: To change the fonts that are used to typeset captions this macro can be used.

macros.name: ChapFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the chapters is stored in this maro.

macros.name: chaptermark
macros.doc: To make headings determined by the sectioning commands, the page style defines the commands \chaptermark, \sectionmark, . . . , where \chaptermark{⟨TEXT⟩} is called by \chapter to set a mark, and so on.

macros.name: indexspace
macros.doc: When a new letter of the alphabet is encountered an amount of \indexspace white space can be added.

macros.name: listoffigures
macros.doc: This macro is used to request that LaTeX produces a list of figures.

macros.name: listoftables
macros.doc: This macro is used to request that LaTeX produces a list of tables.

macros.name: newblock
macros.doc: The default definition for \newblock is to produce a small space.

macros.name: ParaFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the paragraphs is stored in this maro.

macros.name: part
macros.doc: The command to start a new part of our document.

macros.name: PartFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the part is stored in this maro.

macros.name: RunningFonts
macros.doc: Use this macro to change the fonts that are used in the running heads.

macros.name: SParaFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the subparagraphs is stored in this maro.

macros.name: SSectFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the subsections is stored in this maro.

macros.name: SSSectFont
macros.doc: The font used to typeset the subsubsections is stored in this maro.

macros.name: subitem
macros.doc: At the user level the commands \item, \subitem and \subsubitem are used to produce index entries of various levels.

macros.name: subsubitem
macros.doc: At the user level the commands \item, \subitem and \subsubitem are used to produce index entries of various levels.

macros.name: tableofcontents
macros.doc: This macro is used to request that LaTeX produces a table of contents.

macros.name: TitleFont
macros.doc: This selects the font to use in the title of the document.

envs.name: theindex
envs.doc: The environment ‘theindex’ can be used for indices. It makes an index with two columns, with each entry a seperate paragraph.
